name: Noxious Lair Investigation
summary: In the Noxious Lair, Centipaar bugs drain the pools that once lay there. Senior Surveyor Fizzledowser wants to learn who the enemy is, so you bring five insect parts to Alchemist Pestlezugg in Gadgetzan for examination.

sections.title: Parts From the Lair
sections.body: After the Gadgetzan Water Survey, Senior Surveyor Fizzledowser turns to reports of the bugs. They drain the pools that once lay where the Noxious Lair now stands. He knows little about them and wants to learn who the enemy is, so you gather five parts from the Centipaar in the Noxious Lair. Then you take them to Alchemist Pestlezugg in Gadgetzan for examination.

sections.title: What Pestlezugg Finds
sections.body: Alchemist Pestlezugg examines the parts at once. They match no insect form he has seen before. The bugs seem almost as if an outside force controls them. Pestlezugg sends you back to Senior Surveyor Fizzledowser, whose urgent need for help may involve more of the bugs in Tanaris.

faq.q: Why does Senior Surveyor Fizzledowser want insect parts?
faq.answer: Bugs are draining the pools that once lay where the Noxious Lair is, and little else is known about them. The Centipaar parts may help Alchemist Pestlezugg learn what they are.
The Centipaar are found in the Noxious Lair, where water pools once lay.

faq.q: Who receives the insect parts in Gadgetzan?
faq.answer: Alchemist Pestlezugg in Gadgetzan receives the insect parts for examination.
It follows the Gadgetzan Water Survey.
